svg.text: Reference geometry only / NOT FOR MANUFACTURING
2D envelopes from native pcbnew; actual KiCad SVG/3D are separate files.
Red: antenna projection; dashed red SVG: 15 mm other-part reserve.
Blue: plug/cable corridors. Circles: M3 / 7 mm head. Units: mm.
Module/socket heights, hand grip and actual cable tolerances remain unverified.
